brief: Prioritize Camden Green 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-567) for pre-event attention ahead of a younger unit in otherwise similar condition, as its advanced age and history of high loading leave it with a reduced margin against mechanical failure under heat exposure, per MG-023. Where the asset cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure, per MG-023. Note that because this asset uses ONAN cooling, the supplied documents do not cover any specific cooling-stage reduction rules for it, and the guidance on running forced cooling continuously through the overnight period does not apply.
